column1: SPEC — General Ledger, Journal Entries & Close
Multi-entity GL | Automated JEs | Continuous/soft close | Period lock | Ties to all CoA
1. GL DESIGN
• Separate ledger per entity (TVC, R619, SHR, INDA) + consolidation ledger/workspace
• Every JE: entity, date, period, source module, source id, balanced debits=credits, dimensions optional
• Account validation against that entity’s CoA only
2. JOURNAL SOURCES (auto)

AR invoice issue / payment | AP bill / payment | Bank/card match | Payroll import | Commission accrual/payout | Mgmt fee + SS recharge | IC Due To/From | Loan interest/principal | Deferred rev release | Depreciation | Manual adjusting (approval required)
3. STANDARD JE TEMPLATES (implement as code templates)
INV-ISSUE: Dr AR 1100 / Cr Revenue 42xx–44xx (+ tax if any)
INV-PAID: Dr Cash 1000 Operating (or 1090 then 1000) / Cr AR 1100; commission JE; revenue already on issue via 4xxx — NOT separate revenue banks
BILL: Dr Expense 6xxx / Cr AP 2000
BILL-PAY: Dr AP 2000 / Cr Cash 1000 (or card liab). Portal pay posts JE+closes bill immediately; bank feed auto-matches Payment (reconcile only). Feed-first path: match open bill then post same JE.
MGMT-FEE: Sub Dr 6950 / Cr 2450; Parent Dr 141x / Cr 4000
SS-RECHARGE: Sub Dr 61xx–68xx / Cr 2450; Parent Dr 141x / Cr 4100
COMM-ACCRUE: Dr Comm exp / Cr 2250; COMM-PAY: Dr 2250 / Cr Cash
LOAN-PMT: Dr Interest exp + Dr 2500 principal / Cr Cash
DEF-REV: Dr Deferred 2300 / Cr Revenue (schedule)
4. CLOSE CHECKLIST (continuous + period end)

Bank/card rec complete | AR/AP age reviewed | IC balances agree parent↔sub | Revenue cut-off | Deferred rev rollforward | Accruals | Payroll | Commissions true-up | Loans schedule | Eliminations draft | TB balance | Snapshot + lock period
5. PERIOD LOCK
Soft close (warn) → Hard lock (block posting) per entity/period; reopen requires Controls role + audit log
Cursor: No unbalanced JE; idempotent posting from events; full reversal support.
